title: Ravenhook FREE
features:
BEST dahood streamable. Multitude of features, very customizable to your liking.

FEATURES:
- Silent Aim [Hold/Toggle]
- Camera Lock [Hold/Toggle]
- Target Lock [Hold/Toggle]

Settings Settings: 
- Fov customization [Color, Radius, Visible]
- Hit chance
- Aim type [Nearest Player, Nearest Part, Nearest Point]

Camera Settings:
- Realistic Tracking [Smoothing (x,y), Sensativity (x,y)
- Robotic Tracking [Movement Type (first, second), sens]
- Cam Fov [Color, Radius, Visible]
- Aim type [Nearest Player, Nearest Part, Nearest Point]
- Camera Shake (x, y, z)

Ping Settings:
- Ping Prediction
- Auto Ping Prediction

Checks:
- Wallcheck
- Alive
- ForceField
- Knocked Out
- Grabbed

Misc Settings:
- Camera Spin (Good for clips)
- Airshot customization [Jumping / Falling]
- Whitelist players to aimbot
- Animation Player [Greet, Lay]
- Builting Macro (Best macro) [Bind, Mode, Delay]
- Trigger Bot [Built in Velocity Visualizer, Bindable, Delay] (hold / toggle)
- Raid Awareness [Specific player esp, ENEMY / FRIENDLY, Keybind activated]
- Force Resolver
- Performance Mode
